acceptance: Start only after the declared failure-streak chain is terminal/superseded, from current origin/dev in a clean governed task worktree; do not reuse rejected PR code.

Reproduce both 2026-08-01 receipts where signed packets moved to processing then failed with ai_status.py assign timed out after 30s and no canonical task, while the same signed task metadata succeeded through canonical assign after drain returned.
Identify the exact lock owner, lock ordering, call stack, and elapsed phases using scratch-root instrumentation; do not assume the cause from timing alone.

Ensure supervisor packet draining never waits on a governed ai-status subprocess while holding runtime-admission, canonical task-state, event-log, inbox, or replay locks needed by that subprocess. Fetch/verify/claim and apply phases require freshness and ownership checks.

A transient task-state lock timeout must be retryable and must not irreversibly move a valid packet to failed with retryable=false. Define bounded backoff and exact recovery preserving packet identity, signature, replay protection, and at-most-once canonical materialization.

After successful drain require processed receipt, durable admission record, exact task-spec hash, canonical active/archive readback for every task ID, and no receipt-only success. Partial multi-task materialization must have a resumable deterministic fail-closed outcome.

Add deterministic concurrent integration tests with a real canonical event-log fixture, an active full supervisor cycle, signed packet drain, and simultaneous approve/assign/note/reopen commands. Prove governed assign under two seconds p95 and processed plus canonical readback.

Add negatives for duplicate/replay, timeout before any task, timeout after one task, crash between inbox rename and receipt, stale processing claim, forged retry, concurrent drainers, mismatched spec, and restart recovery without duplicate assignment.
Preserve journal integrity, runtime lock ordering, provider dispatch, worker leases, reviewer independence, signature verification, artifact guards, and existing successful bridge receipts.
Run focused bridge/supervisor suites, relevant full supervisor regression, captured 2000-event concurrency benchmark, py_compile, JSON evidence validation, local trailer gate, and git diff --check.
No config, canonical runtime JSON/event-log, provider policy, product controller, live service, signal/restart, or product-task materialization changes in this source task.
Keep generated task briefs, packets, dashboards, runtime state, and unrelated files out. Evidence stays review_pending until Human/Ops exact-head approval.
Deliver clean PR to dev with <=72-character Task-ID-prefixed subjects and exact Antigravity/Task-ID/Human-Ops/truthful Verified trailers; wait checks and independent review.
Rollout is source merge followed by separately governed runtime promotion canary. Rollback is revert; no config migration.
